data.body: LANDED: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1054 (merged as 61741d248, Gerrit server-side rebase of Iad49af4b). Delivered: (1) routing key "web": true on T1 in criteria_routing.json; (2) descriptor passthrough (normalized bool) in criteria/model.py; (3) RunRequest.web threaded by pass1_chunk for AGENT-tier chunks only; (4) runner attaches Anthropic's server-side web_search via pydantic-ai capabilities (Agent(capabilities=[WebSearch()]), supported successor of builtin_tools), gated beside the cache-settings seam — non-anthropic providers, unflagged criteria, and model_override runs build byte-identical Agent kwargs (unit-tested); (5) T1 rubric describes conditional availability + codebase/plan fallback, no fabricated citations. Tests: tests/unit/test_web_tool_gating.py (9 tests); full unit suite 6043 passed post-rebase; lint+typecheck green. Gates: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved. Closed --class preexisting (rubric shipped mandating a tool the agent toolset never had).
